Travel Food

You salt, wrap and dry the ingredients, packing a little hospitality for the road.

Rules

- ID: recipe-travel-food - Permission: Trail Workshop, Make Something Useful, Enchanting Workshop, or a mixing card that explicitly grants this recipe; the recipe alone grants no crafting permission - Tools: Craft tools or the granting card’s mixing kit - Materials per attempt: Safe edible forage, obtained in the scene or one compatible carried bundle use - Time per attempt: One hour - Result: Inventory supply, maximum d8

Roll the crafting card’s attribute. Weak raises one matching supply by 1 inventory step; Standard by 2; Strong by 3, up to the printed cap. The first step from out creates d4; later steps are d6, d8, d10, d12, d20. Check carried material supply after the attempt. No group crafting.

@UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b056a97d404b4adb.JournalEntryPage.8220b0d2885b2af0]{Product}. This recipe can be one of the two ordinary choices granted by Trail Workshop or Ordinary Recipe Study. It is reusable and does not grant free ingredients.
